notes: Fixed canvas preview appearing far off-screen (~600px down) after adding images. Root cause: missing min-height: 0 on nested flex items (#app, .canvas-area, .canvas-container) in a column flex chain. Without min-height: 0, flex items default to min-height: auto which prevents proper height constraint inheritance through the flex chain, causing containers to expand beyond the viewport. Fix: added #app { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; min-height: 0; } plus min-height: 0 to .canvas-area and .canvas-container. Used world-review subagent for analysis and playwright-cli for measurement verification.
